positions.name: CalibrationVerificationRecord
positions.frame: what establishes that an instrument's calibration is settled — narrative confirmation and structured field-record together, and how do they relate?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional read across the dimensional passes: flat technical register with no performance (FlatTechnicalLogbook), present/realis/concrete temporal grounding, authority-ranking relational stance ratifying the instrument's readiness, expert/informational power grounded in method rather than rank, and a competence-value appeal to verification against named reference plates. src-1 delivers this as connected prose ('is now calibrated', 'We verified'), while src-2 and src-3 compress the same facts into structured field labels under a split footing (Xena animating/authoring, Quill as principal) — same claim, two formats. The conviction read is uniform 'claim' level across all three: unhedged but not ratified into decision. The set holds together as one true-because-of-what-it-describes account of the calibration's verified status, narrated two ways rather than as separate assertions.
